temporal_controls: Open Temporal Controls for the current selection. Choose a control system, position and orientation spaces, a label, and a color. Each object gets a matching control that carries its animation keys and drives it through the chosen spaces.
temporal_controls_super_mode: Speed up baking with Maya's faster math-based bake shortcut instead of evaluating the scene at every frame. Affects both Bake Frames and Bake Keys.
temporal_controls_world_space: Re-drive the selected Temporal Controls through World Space instead of tearing them down and recreating them.
temporal_controls_object_space: Re-drive the selected Temporal Controls through Object Space instead of tearing them down and recreating them.
temporal_controls_camera_space: Re-drive the selected Temporal Controls through Camera Space instead of tearing them down and recreating them.
temporal_controls_relative_space: Re-drive the selected Temporal Controls through Relative Space instead of tearing them down and recreating them.
temporal_controls_child_space: Re-drive the selected Temporal Controls through Child Space instead of tearing them down and recreating them.
temporal_controls_mute_revert: Disconnect the selected Temporal Controls and restore their objects, but keep the controls in the scene to drive again later.
temporal_controls_toggle_rig: Toggle selected Temporal Control rigs off or on. Off restores the source animation; on snapshots that live animation back into the control's current space and reconnects the rig.
temporal_controls_mute_bake: Disconnect the selected Temporal Controls, leaving their objects wherever the drive left them, but keep the controls in the scene to drive again later.
temporal_controls_bake: Extract the selected Temporal Controls' keyframes onto their original objects and remove the controls.
If nothing is selected, bakes every Temporal Control in the scene.
temporal_controls_revert: Remove the selected Temporal Controls and restore their original objects' animation and connections.
If nothing is selected, reverts every Temporal Control in the scene.
temporal_controls_panel: Browse and manage every Temporal Control in the scene.
